title: Your First Web Page
reflection_prompt: What was it like to change code that was already written, instead of writing it yourself?

exercises.title: Make This Page Yours
description: This page already has real HTML and CSS written for it — you don't need to write any code from scratch yet. Your job is to edit what's already there.
Look at the HTML panel. Anywhere you see text inside square brackets, like [YOUR NAME HERE], that's a placeholder — delete it (brackets and all) and type your own text in its place.
• In the first section, replace [YOUR NAME HERE] with your actual name.
• In the second section, replace [Favorite Movie] with the title of a movie you like, and replace [Your Initials] with your initials.
• In the third section, replace [Song 1], [Song 2], and [Song 3] with three real songs you like.

Now look at the CSS panel. Find the rule for .songs-section — it has a line that starts with background-color:. Change the color after the colon to any color you like. You can type a plain color word (lightpink, orange, turquoise...) or a hex code like #ffb6c1 — either works. Check the live preview on the right to see the color change.
Click Run Tests when you're done to check your work.
